summary: Backend regression and production build passed. Public auth UI loads with MahaFlow branding and authority modal controls. Turnstile in automation fails with Cloudflare challenge-adapter/DNS path (600010 context), not old hostname 110200. Authenticated role workspace traversal remained blocked in this automation context despite attempted MOCKED session fixtures.

integration_issues.flow: MOCKED authenticated workspace traversal (Passenger/Authority/Developer + authority onboarding)
integration_issues.issue: Automation could not transition into authenticated app state with injected MOCKED Supabase session fixtures; app remained on public auth page, so full role workspace navigation/mobile drawer checks under authenticated context could not be completed.

action_items: Main agent should run/attach a deterministic MOCKED auth/session test harness (or explicit test-mode entry) to enable authenticated route traversal automation.
Add missing data-testid attributes for remaining interactive controls (especially settings/form controls and branding preview action).
Keep Turnstile incident classified as adapter/DNS automation limitation (600010 path), not old hostname 110200.
critical_code_review_comments: Data-testid coverage is incomplete for multiple interactive controls (forms/settings/branding preview), which reduces stable UI automation reliability.
Current UI code has no obvious runtime placeholder regressions in reviewed files; legacy Mongo endpoints are correctly retired behind HTTP 410 in backend API.
Google Maps loader path is env-driven and external endpoint check returned HTTP 200 with preview Referer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public auth and Turnstile behavior validated. Backend/API retirement checks and build are green. Authenticated role-page automation is still blocked in this run due inability to establish MOCKED Supabase session state in browser runtime; continue from this by implementing explicit test-mode auth fixture or confirmed session seeding format.
rca of the issue: Repro: open app with injected localStorage/sessionStorage MOCKED auth payload and mocked Supabase REST/RPC routes; app still resolves to unauthenticated AuthPage. Likely root cause is Supabase auth-js session bootstrap contract mismatch in automation (storage/session/user synchronization) or additional runtime auth checks beyond seeded payload. Mitigation: add app-level test hook (e.g., guarded test-only mock session adapter) for deterministic role traversal in CI/e2e without real OAuth.
